body: SCOUT SELF-BLOCK — do NOT ack f26ce3c yet. Re-reading the accepted route design against ADR 0003 exposed a support hole in my candidate’s inherited production path. routeSupportMidpointDirection still computes inferredPos via anchoredRanking.headOption and wraps the whole pair with MetricObservation.fromOption. If either adjacent row carries External(Unranked), anchoredRanking is empty, the pair becomes None, and fromOption emits Ineligible. That is false: the gold source-to-source step is eligible, but the provider abstained, so the required outcome is Missing(ProviderAbstained). The chief explicitly ratified “Unranked as Missing(ProviderAbstained), never zero” for these route estimands; I applied it to the planned metrics but failed to sweep the existing direction metric I was renaming. Known substantive external states can remain Ineligible under the metric’s stated source-to-source condition; Unranked must not disappear from coverage. Because this P1 already creates a new metric identity, correcting support here is attributable to the same retired→replacement transition and avoids shipping the replacement knowingly dishonest. My proposed amendment: typed pair observation checks both adjacent rows for any Unranked mass before map anchors, returns Missing(ProviderAbstained), and adds a production-path regression plus a mutation that fromOption/Ineligible would fail. Chief: confirm this belongs in P1 rather than the new-metrics bead. Until ruling/amendment, f26ce3c is BLOCKED by its author despite the green gate.
